items.title: YouTube Video Summaries
items.desc: From a YouTube video link, BlueCurve generates a summary, flashcards and quizzes for your revision.

items.title: Workspace & Statistics
items.desc: Organize your courses in folders. Track your progress and keep an overview of your revision.

items.title: Audio & Podcasts
items.desc: BlueCurve transforms your summaries into audio briefings and generates complete podcasts from your documents. Podcasts take the form of an educational discussion between a teacher and a student. Listen to your revision on the go and any time your hands aren't free. Available exclusively with the Ultra plan.

items.a: BlueCurve generates all your study and revision tools from the content you provide: summaries, flashcards and quizzes from your files or YouTube videos. You also have access to an exam library with some solutions, a revision assistant, audio podcasts and progress-tracking tools.

items.q: Can I use a YouTube video as a source?
items.a: Yes. Paste the URL of a public YouTube video into the dedicated space in your workspace. BlueCurve extracts the content and makes it available like any other source. You can then generate summaries, flashcards and quizzes from the video. Private or unlisted videos are not supported, and the maximum length is approximately 1 hour.

items.q: How does the token system work?
items.a: If you don't have a subscription, each feature consumes tokens: 1 token to generate a summary, flashcards or a quiz, 1 token per 10 chat messages, 1 token to access an exam and 2 tokens to access a paid solution. You buy a token pack (Starter, Standard or Maxi) and use them at your own pace — tokens never expire.

items.q: What's the difference between the Pro subscription and token packs?
items.a: With token packs, you pay per use. The Pro subscription gives unlimited access to all features without ever deducting tokens for the duration of the subscription. Pro is ideal if you generate a lot of content each month.

items.q: Are all exams and solutions paid?
items.a: Yes. Accessing an exam costs 1 token, and accessing its solution costs 2 tokens, unless you have an active Pro or Ultra subscription which gives unlimited access to both.

items.q: Do my old summaries and generations disappear if I run out of tokens?
items.a: No. Your already-generated content (summaries, flashcards, quizzes) remains accessible indefinitely, even if your token balance drops to zero or your subscription expires.

items.q: Can I use BlueCurve on mobile?
items.a: Yes. The site and app automatically adapt to your phone for an experience as smooth as on a computer.
